title: Ensemble-Monitor Gain Replicated with Cheap Open Monitors

original_idea.body: # Ensemble-Monitor Gain Replicated with Cheap Open Monitors

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: ensembling is the cheapest lever for weak monitors; payoff curve informs control-monitoring infrastructure.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: ControlArena trajectories + vary ensemble size, inference-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: detection gain per added sample vs compute cost on fixed trajectories.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected monitoring infrastructure for independent deployers; no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Replay + multi-sample monitor inference on consumer hardware.

novelty.reasoning: Ensemble monitor exists; weak-open-monitor payoff curve may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Ensembling gain at the weak-open-monitor end likely uncharacterized.
